plugins.name: founder-of-the-year
plugins.description: Confident, attractive founder profiles for Claude Code: gathers from the founder's own sources first, asks one short batch of questions, checks every claim, then writes a magazine-style feature as Markdown, HTML and PDF with a separate verification sheet. Honestly labelled; never implies an award.

metadata.description: A single-plugin marketplace for Founder of the Year: a founder-profile workflow for Claude Code (one skill, four agents) that gathers before it asks and writes a confident, evidence-backed feature. Founder-prepared and AI-assisted; never implies an award.
